require 'json';require 'digest';require 'fileutils';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);base=File.expand_path('../nested-row-candidate-2026-10-30',o);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};raise 'existing' if File.exist?(o+'/report.json')
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,runtime:'b1bf786',identities:[__FILE__,base+'/candidate-kujo',base+'/task-allocation-probe'].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(o+'/report.json.tmp',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n");File.rename(o+'/report.json.tmp',o+'/report.json')};save.call
begin
 [8,2048].product([64,1024],[1,8]).each do |width,iterations,calls|
  dir=o+"/fixtures/#{width}-#{iterations}-#{calls}";FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
  owner="mut state:=[#{(['0']*width).join(',')}]\nexport func snapshot(){return state}\nexport func update(n){mut i:=0 while i<#{iterations} {state[0]=[n+i] state[1]={\"v\":n+i} i+=1} return n}\n"
  main="from owner import snapshot,update\nlet original:=snapshot() mut n:=1 while n<=#{calls} {assert_equal(update(n),n) n+=1} let final:=snapshot() assert_equal(len(final),#{width}) assert_equal(final[0],[#{calls+iterations-1}]) assert_equal(final[1],{\"v\":#{calls+iterations-1}}) mut k:=0 while k<#{width} {assert_equal(original[k],0) if k>=2 {assert_equal(final[k],0)} k+=1} print(\"REPEATED ARRAY KEYS PASS\")\n"
  File.write(dir+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(dir+'/main.kujo',main)
  %w[owner main].each{|name|p=dir+'/'+name+'.kujo';r[:sources][p]={source:File.read(p),sha256:sha.call(p)}}
  meta={width:width,iterations:iterations,calls:calls,path:dir+'/main.kujo'}
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   args=[base+'/task-allocation-probe',mode,meta[:path]];out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*args);m=err.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise out+err unless s.success?&&m&&out=="REPEATED ARRAY KEYS PASS\n"
   r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i)
  end
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[base+'/candidate-kujo','run',meta[:path],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*args);raise out+err unless s.success?&&out=="REPEATED ARRAY KEYS PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus)
  end
  save.call
 end
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'identity' unless sha.call(p)==h};raise 'coverage' unless r[:rows].size==16&&r[:semantics].size==24
 r[:status]='measured';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

require 'json'
require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)
r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/report.json'))
raise 'status' unless r['status']=='measured'
r.fetch('identities').each{|p,h|raise "identity #{p}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
r.fetch('sources').each{|p,v|raise "source #{p}" unless File.read(p)==v['source'] && Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==v['sha256']}
base=File.expand_path('../nested-row-candidate-2026-10-30',o)
expected=[8,2048].product([64,1024],[1,8])
[['rows',%w[vm jit]],['semantics',%w[vm interpreter jit]]].each do |kind,modes|
 rows=r.fetch(kind)
 raise 'coverage' unless rows.map{|v|v.values_at('width','iterations','calls','mode')}==expected.flat_map{|v|modes.map{|m|v+[m]}}
 rows.each do |v|
  path=o+"/fixtures/#{v['width']}-#{v['iterations']}-#{v['calls']}/main.kujo"
  args=kind=='rows' ? [base+'/task-allocation-probe',v['mode'],path] : [base+'/candidate-kujo','run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(v['mode']=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+v['mode']])
  raise 'execution' unless v['argv']==args && v['path']==path && v['exit']==0 && v['stdout']=="REPEATED ARRAY KEYS PASS\n"
  if kind=='rows'
   m=v['stderr'].match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise 'counters' unless m && v['requests']==m[1].to_i && v['bytes']==m[2].to_i
  end
 end
end
slopes=[8,2048].product([64,1024],%w[vm jit]).map do |width,iterations,mode|
 a,b=[1,8].map{|calls|r['rows'].find{|v|v.values_at('width','iterations','calls','mode')==[width,iterations,calls,mode]}}
 {width:width,iterations:iterations,mode:mode,bytes_per_call:(b['bytes']-a['bytes'])/7.0,requests_per_call:(b['requests']-a['requests'])/7.0}
end
receipt={status:'verified',report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/report.json').hexdigest,allocation_observations:16,semantic_checks:24,slopes:slopes}
File.write(o+'/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(receipt)+"\n")
puts JSON.pretty_generate(receipt)

require 'json'; require 'digest'; require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);base=File.expand_path('../dictionary-batch-candidate-2026-10-30',o)
r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/report.json')); raise 'existing refresh' if File.exist?(o+'/v4.json')
comparison=JSON.parse(File.read(base+'/comparison.json'))
identities=comparison.fetch('identities').select{|p,_|p.end_with?('/candidate-kujo','/task-allocation-probe','/libkujo.rlib')}
verify=->{identities.each{|p,h|raise 'identity' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h};r['sources'].each{|p,v|raise 'fixture' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==v['sha256']}}
verify.call
out={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,baseline_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/report.json').hexdigest,identities:identities,rows:[],semantics:[]}
save=->{File.write(o+'/v4.json.tmp',JSON.pretty_generate(out)+"\n");File.rename(o+'/v4.json.tmp',o+'/v4.json')};save.call
begin
 %w[rows semantics].each do |kind|
  r[kind].each do |row|
   args=row['argv'].dup;args[0]=base+'/'+File.basename(args[0]);stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success? && stdout==row['stdout']
   item=row.merge('argv'=>args,'stdout'=>stdout,'stderr'=>stderr,'exit'=>status.exitstatus)
   if kind=='rows'
    m=stderr.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise 'counter' unless m
    item['requests']=m[1].to_i;item['bytes']=m[2].to_i
   end
   out[kind.to_sym]<<item;save.call
  end
 end
 verify.call;out[:status]='measured';save.call
rescue=>e;out[:status]='failed';out[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);a=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/report.json'));b=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/v4.json'));base=File.expand_path('../dictionary-batch-candidate-2026-10-30',o)
raise 'incomplete' unless b['status']=='measured' && b['baseline_sha256']==Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/report.json').hexdigest
b['identities'].each{|p,h|raise 'identity' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
a['sources'].each{|p,v|raise 'fixture' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==v['sha256']}
%w[rows semantics].each do |kind|
 raise 'coverage' unless a[kind].size==b[kind].size
 a[kind].zip(b[kind]).each do |old,now|
  %w[width iterations calls mode path stdout exit].each{|k|raise k unless old[k]==now[k]}
  args=old['argv'].dup;args[0]=base+'/'+File.basename(args[0]);raise 'argv' unless now['argv']==args
  if kind=='rows'
   m=now['stderr'].match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise 'counters' unless m && now['requests']==m[1].to_i && now['bytes']==m[2].to_i
  end
 end
end
slopes=[8,2048].product([64,1024],%w[vm jit]).map do |w,i,m|
 x,y=[1,8].map{|c|b['rows'].find{|r|r.values_at('width','iterations','calls','mode')==[w,i,c,m]}}
 {width:w,iterations:i,mode:m,bytes_per_call:(y['bytes']-x['bytes'])/7.0,requests_per_call:(y['requests']-x['requests'])/7.0}
end
r={status:'verified',candidate_accepted:false,allocation_observations:16,semantic_checks:24,report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/v4.json').hexdigest,slopes:slopes}
File.write(o+'/v4-verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n");puts JSON.pretty_generate(r)
